root: ^You: Please — I need you to listen to me. There's an iceberg ahead.
^Passenger: (laughing) An iceberg! Ha! My dear boy, this is the Titanic. She is unsinkable — everyone says so. Did someone put you up to this?

c-0:
^You: I understand it sounds strange, but I promise I'm telling the truth.

^Passenger: Well, aren't you earnest. Go and enjoy the evening, dear boy.
c-1:
^You: Nothing is unsinkable! People could die!

^Passenger: (laughs harder) Oh, how dramatic! Wonderful, really — you should be on the stage.
c-2:
^You: Laugh all you want. You'll see.

^Passenger: (stops laughing, offended) Well! There's no need for that tone.
